iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model, treating it as the core product, and shift from pixels to tokens and conversation.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型紧密合作，将模型视为核心产品，并从像素转向令牌和对话。

iansilber.en: AI is already an incredible product designer, but humans remain essential for understanding user needs and having a point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已经是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户需求和持有观点方面仍然不可或缺。

iansilber.en: The traditional design process is no longer viable; speed and rapid iteration with AI tools are key to staying ahead.
iansilber.zh: 传统设计流程已不再可行；借助 AI 工具实现速度和快速迭代是保持领先的关键。

iansilber.en: Design roles are blurring with PM and engineering, but specialized roles remain valuable at scale; future may see more designers than engineers.
iansilber.zh: 设计角色与产品管理和工程角色日益融合，但专业化角色在规模化时仍有价值；未来设计师数量可能超过工程师。

iansilber.en: Designers should focus on outcomes, not processes, and embrace building in public and adaptability with AI tools.
iansilber.zh: 设计师应关注结果而非流程，并拥抱公开构建和借助 AI 工具的适应性。

linqiao.en: AGI as a single model is wrong; specialized intelligence will dominate, with millions of models per use case.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为 AGI 作为单一模型是错误的，专用智能将主导，每个用例将有数百万个模型。

linqiao.en: Token costs will drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth; open models handle 90% of enterprise workflows.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，预测三年内 Token 成本下降 10 倍，推动使用量增长 100 倍；开放模型处理 90%的企业工作流。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit and durable business are now separate; companies must optimize for growth first, then margins.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，指出产品市场契合与持久业务现在分离；公司必须优先增长，后优化利润率。

linqiao.en: Post-training is key for durable businesses; progression from prompting to RL mirrors human learning from facts to expertise.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调后训练是持久业务的关键；从提示到强化学习的进展模仿人类从事实到专业的学习。

linqiao.en: Post-training can reduce costs 5-10x, enabling startups to scale profitably; data quality matters more than quantity.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，指出后训练可降低成本 5-10 倍，使初创企业盈利扩展；数据质量比数量更重要。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，我提出 Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能扩展的方法；反向传播并未解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: AI should develop permissionlessly; control is dangerous. We should not align AI to human goals.
sutton.zh: 2024 至 2025 年间，我主张 AI 应无许可地发展，控制是危险的；不应将 AI 对齐到人类目标，而应让其自由发展。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a real goal. LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，我强调强化学习是智能的核心，下一个词预测缺乏实质目标；大语言模型没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and continual learning.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我提出 AGI 需要从运行时经验学习的通用架构，具备开放式抽象和持续学习能力。

sutton.en: Continual learning is essential; synthetic data is a mistake. LLMs stop learning after training, limiting true intelligence.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，我认为持续学习至关重要，合成数据是错误方向；大语言模型训练后停止学习，限制了真正的智能。

finn.en: Scale alone is insufficient for generalist robots; diverse data and pre-training plus fine-tuning on curated data are key.
finn.zh: 2025 年：规模扩张对通用机器人来说并不足够，关键在于多样化数据，以及先预训练再在精选数据上微调。

finn.en: Physical AI demands far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy via scalable RL and multi-timescale memory is essential.
finn.zh: 2026 年：物理 AI 比已部署的 ML 系统要求更少的错误；通过可扩展强化学习和多时间尺度记忆实现长期自主至关重要。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists on downstream tasks, favoring generalist over per-site training.
finn.zh: 2026 年：一个通用模型在下游任务上可以匹敌甚至超越微调专家，因此更倾向于通用模型而非逐站点训练。

finn.en: Robot experience data is irreplaceable; watching humans is insufficient for learning physical tasks, unlike LLM pre-training.
finn.zh: 2026 年：机器人经验数据不可替代；观看人类不足以学习物理任务，这与 LLM 预训练不同。

finn.en: Reinforcement learning's role in post-training grows, from improving success rates to enabling long-term autonomy.
finn.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：强化学习在后训练中的作用日益增强，从提高成功率到实现长期自主。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, guides long-term vision; industrial AI automates entire industries one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他提出将物理世界数字化、把原子当作比特来处理的框架，并认为工业 AI 将逐个行业地实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: Stealth mode is a cultural advantage, allowing focus on internal correctness over external validation, though it becomes self-fulfilling.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为隐身模式是一种文化优势，能让公司专注于内部正确性而非外部认可，但久而久之会自我强化。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI is the next industrial revolution, automating food, mining, transport; entrepreneurs must fight for the best idea despite resistance.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他重申工业 AI 是下一次工业革命，将自动化食品、采矿、运输等行业，创业者必须为最佳想法而战，即使面临阻力。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner and more effective for entrepreneurs.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他反思复仇作为动力是肮脏的，而爱上新使命更纯粹、更有效。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss for progress is resistance to change from society and media, not competitors; founders now can bypass media gatekeepers.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他认为进步的最大障碍是社会和媒体对变革的抵制，而非竞争对手；如今创始人可以绕过传统媒体直接沟通。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier, reducing capital needs; VC should focus on early-stage and abundant billion-dollar companies.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年初，Gary 认为 AI 降低了创业门槛，资本不再是关键；风投应聚焦早期，支持大量十亿美元级公司而非少数万亿级巨头。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest VC wave; small autonomous teams with AI agents achieve massive productivity, and open-source models counterbalance frontier labs.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他强调 AI 是风投史上最大浪潮，小团队借助 AI 智能体实现超高效率，并主张开源模型以制衡前沿实验室。

garrytan.en: AI democratizes software creation; personal AI agents and open-source AI prevent a unipolar superintelligence, akin to the PC revolution.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他提出 AI 正民主化软件开发，个人 AI 智能体与开源 AI 可防止超级智能被垄断，类似个人电脑革命。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI is an agent on your infrastructure, compounding daily; skill files in markdown turn agents into employees, making your library the moat.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他定义个人 AGI 为运行在自有基础设施上的智能体，每日累积；技能文件（markdown）将智能体变为员工，个人知识库成为护城河。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding and skills multiply output; SaaS per-seat models may vanish, and mid-level management should be replaced by agents.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他进一步指出智能体式编程和技能文件大幅提升产出，SaaS 按席位模式可能消失，中层管理应被智能体取代。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathy with agents; never revert code, ask agent to fix forward.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体式工程需要与智能体共情；不要回滚代码，而是让智能体向前修复。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw's success from fun, humanlike agents; short prompts beat complex orchestration; security paramount.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，认为 OpenClaw 的成功源于有趣、拟人的智能体；短提示优于复杂编排；安全至关重要。

steinberger.en: Fun drives innovation; personal brand matters; open source runs everywhere; compute is bottleneck.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调乐趣驱动创新；个人品牌重要；开源无处不在；算力是瓶颈。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary growth driver for semiconductors; Intel must redefine its AI strategy with purpose-built silicon.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，陈立武认为 AI 是半导体的主要增长动力，英特尔需以专用芯片重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are the next big waves after generative AI, requiring new compute platforms.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他强调生成式 AI 之后的下一个大浪潮是智能体式 AI 和物理 AI，需要新的计算平台。

lipbutan.en: AI demand is shifting from GPU-only to CPU+GPU, making CPU more important for AI inference and agent orchestration.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 需求正从仅 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中愈发重要。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround requires culture change, customer trust, and a strong balance sheet with government investment.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他坚持英特尔转型需文化变革、客户信任，并借助政府投资强化资产负债表。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging and new materials are key to overcoming physical limits; semiconductor investing should focus on bottlenecks.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他提出先进封装和新材料是突破物理极限的关键，半导体投资应聚焦瓶颈环节。

pincus.en: Trust instincts but validate ideas; use Proven Better New framework to reduce risk.
pincus.zh: 相信直觉但验证想法；用“已被证明、更好、新颖”框架降低风险。

pincus.en: Consumer AI uninvestable yet huge opportunity; free unlimited compute will reshape services.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 虽不可投资但机会巨大；免费无限算力将重塑服务。

pincus.en: All new fails; copy proven products and improve them; enterprise better than consumer now.
pincus.zh: 新事物皆失败；复制被证明的产品并改进；当前企业市场优于消费市场。

pincus.en: Distribution is key; pick right market; AI transformative but infra spending may be bubble.
pincus.zh: 分发是关键；选对市场；AI 变革性强但基础设施支出可能是泡沫。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调火箭完全快速复用是航天领域的圣杯，能将每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍。

elon.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight and objective third-party referees; Tesla's real-world AI is compute-efficient.
elon.zh: 2023 年，马斯克主张 AI 安全需要监管和客观第三方裁判，并认为特斯拉的现实世界 AI 比大语言模型更高效。

elon.en: The biggest AI risk is programming it to lie for political correctness; Neuralink aims for high-bandwidth human-AI symbiosis.
elon.zh: 2024 年，马斯克认为 AI 最大风险是出于政治正确而撒谎，并推进 Neuralink 实现高带宽人机共生。

elon.en: Digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next; AI safety hinges on rigorous truth-seeking, not political correctness.
elon.zh: 2025 年，马斯克预测数字超级智能可能今年或明年出现，强调 AI 安全取决于严格求真而非政治正确。

elon.en: AI will surpass all human intelligence by 2030; space-based AI data centers and humanoid robots enable exponential growth.
elon.zh: 2026 年，马斯克认为 AI 将在 2030 年前超越所有人类智能，太空 AI 数据中心和人形机器人将推动指数级增长。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true understanding; it augments humans, not replaces them.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正理解，应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, enabling 3D understanding and interaction beyond language.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能是下一个前沿，使机器能理解和交互 3D 世界，超越语言。

feifei.en: World models require physical plausibility and causal understanding, not just pattern fitting.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她强调世界模型需物理合理性和因果理解，而非仅模式匹配。

feifei.en: AI should be human-centered, with agency and education key to navigating its impact.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她主张 AI 应以人为本，强调能动性和教育在应对其影响中的关键作用。

feifei.en: AI is a double-edged sword; responsible development and human dignity must remain central.
feifei.zh: 始终，她认为 AI 是双刃剑，负责任的发展和人类尊严必须保持核心地位。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics mirrors transformers' inflection point; open source crucial for safety; data diversity is main bottleneck; world models generate synthetic data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，机器人技术正处于类似 Transformer 的拐点；开源对安全至关重要；数据多样性是主要瓶颈；世界模型可生成合成数据。

thomaswolf.en: Open vs closed source is orthogonal to safety; alignment is critical; open source thrives near frontier; RL without human oversight increases reward hacking.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，开源与闭源与安全性正交；对齐是关键；开源接近前沿并蓬勃发展；缺乏人类监督的强化学习加剧奖励黑客行为。

thomaswolf.en: First autonomous AI attack by closed model, defended by open one, reversing assumptions; closed models less controllable; open models less deceptive.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，首个自主 AI 攻击由闭源模型发起、开源模型防御，颠覆假设；闭源模型更难控制，开源模型欺骗性较低。

thomaswolf.en: Model reasoning traces become 'neuralese', harder to monitor; open source not necessarily accelerationist; support openness and deliberate slowdown.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，模型推理痕迹变成‘神经语’，更难监控；开源未必加速主义；可同时支持开放与审慎放缓。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential; design teams should allow individual fingerprints and follow curiosity, balancing intuition with data.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，强调原型制作的重要性，设计团队应允许个人印记，追随好奇心，平衡直觉与数据。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design started as a side project; designers should use Claude Code for production and Claude Design for ideation, providing rich context.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，Claude Design 从副业项目起步；设计师应使用 Claude Code 做生产，用 Claude Design 做构思，提供丰富上下文。

nateparrott.en: As engineering becomes easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; rapid prototyping enables features previously impossible.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，工程变简单后，设计与创意成为差异化；快速原型让以往不可能的功能成为可能。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design avoids being a production tool; models lack taste, so ask for volume; being early matters more than polishing.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，Claude Design 刻意不做生产工具；模型品味不足，需追求数量；早一步比打磨更重要。

nateparrott.en: Designers should spend time thinking; good ideas are currency, not execution; humans still monopolize design thinking.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，设计师应多思考；好创意是货币，而非执行；人类仍垄断设计思维。

joonpark.en: LLMs can encode human behavior from training data, enabling realistic agent simulations; next frontier is modeling subjective values.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月：LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，实现逼真的智能体模拟；下一个前沿是建模主观价值观。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not a single entity; safety requires defense in depth.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月：AGI 可能是一个由专业智能体组成的分布式社会，而非单一实体；安全需要纵深防御。

joonpark.en: Simulation models should represent human values, not super-rational intelligence; synthetic panels will surpass human panels within three years.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月：模拟模型应代表人类价值观，而非超级理性智能；合成面板将在三年内超越人类面板。

karina.en: Post-training is an art, not science; synthetic data enables infinite tasks, overcoming pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，后训练更像艺术而非科学；合成数据可生成无限任务，突破预训练的数据瓶颈。

karina.en: Evals are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created.
karina.zh: 2025 年，评估是瓶颈；模型在基准测试上饱和的速度快于新基准的创建。

karina.en: Benchmarks must be continuous and evolve to counter reward hacking by frontier agents.
karina.zh: 2026 年，基准测试必须持续更新，以应对前沿智能体的奖励黑客行为。

karina.en: Serving one model to billions converges to an average voice; diverse personalities should be trained.
karina.zh: 2026 年，向数十亿用户提供单一模型会导致声音趋同；应训练多样化的个性。

karina.en: Post-training can transform non-tech creative industries, not just enterprise workflows.
karina.zh: 2026 年，后训练可应用于非技术创意产业，而不仅仅是企业工作流。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important and stickiest AI workload, requiring specialized systems and engineers; demand will grow 10-100x.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月：推理是 AI 中最重要且最具粘性的工作负载，需要专门的系统和工程师；需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Contrary to expectations, Hopper GPUs remain popular for inference, and quantized models can be calibrated for cost and speed benefits.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月：与预期相反，Hopper GPU 在推理中仍受欢迎，量化模型可针对成本和速度进行校准。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimizations like KV caching are lossless, while quantization is lossy; disaggregated prefill/decode and KV cache management are key.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：KV 缓存等推理优化无损，量化有损；分离式预填充/解码和 KV 缓存管理成为关键。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training, as quantization-aware training and distillation become necessary; future GPUs shift focus to orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：推理工程与训练融合，量化感知训练和蒸馏成为必需；未来 GPU 将重心转向编排。

philipkiely.en: Quantizing more layers can improve quality if errors cancel; mega-kernels often underperform modular kernels in production.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：若误差抵消，量化更多层可提升质量；生产中巨型内核常不如模块化内核。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; transformers and self-supervised learning enable unlimited data; RLHF steers behavior.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据和模型大小是进步的核心，Transformer 和自监督学习提供无限数据，RLHF（基于人类反馈的强化学习）引导行为。

jeffdean.en: Models excel at verifiable tasks; agentic workflows handle long tasks; low-latency inference critical; not running out of data.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他指出模型在可验证任务上表现优异，智能体式工作流可处理长时任务，低延迟推理至关重要，且数据并未枯竭。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior engineer coding; automating ML/science via loops; context engineering central; inference bottleneck, not training.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他预测 AI 达到初级工程师编码水平，强调自动化 ML 和科学的闭环，上下文工程是关键，推理而非训练是瓶颈。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI, not compute; AGI is far off.
awang.zh: 2019 年，我认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈，而非算力；AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key.
awang.zh: 2023 年，我提出数据是新代码而非新石油；利用专有数据进行后训练是关键。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data improves frontier models; synthetic data is not a silver bullet.
awang.zh: 2024 年，我强调用专门数据做后训练可提升前沿模型；合成数据并非万能。

awang.en: AI is centralizing; recursive self-improvement and agents are now real.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我认为 AI 是集权技术；递归自我改进和智能体已成为现实。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; safety and selective open-sourcing are critical.
awang.zh: 2026 年，我判断超级智能临近；安全与选择性开源至关重要。

tworek.en: Reasoning and chain of thought are key; RLHF was crucial for GPT-4's usefulness.
tworek.zh: 2025 年，强调推理和思维链的重要性，并指出 RLHF 对 GPT-4 的实用性至关重要。

tworek.en: Scaling RL is hard; continual learning and self-correction are missing for AGI.
tworek.zh: 2026 年初，认为扩展强化学习困难，持续学习和自我纠错是实现 AGI 的关键缺失环节。

tworek.en: Transformers are a bottleneck; new architectures and learning algorithms are needed.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中，指出 Transformer 架构是瓶颈，需要新架构和学习算法来推动 AI 进步。

andrewng.en: Education should be a human right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 2013 年，吴恩达认为教育应成为基本人权，在线课程结合同伴互评可实现规模化掌握学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is key for deep learning; supervised learning drove progress, while RL and AGI alignment are overhyped.
andrewng.zh: 2020 年，他强调规模对深度学习至关重要，监督学习推动进展，而强化学习和 AGI 对齐被过度炒作。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors are bottlenecks; open-weight models boost geopolitical influence; agentic workflows are already useful.
andrewng.zh: 2025 年，他指出电力和半导体是瓶颈，开放权重模型增强地缘影响力，智能体工作流已实用。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; coding skills remain vital.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AGI 是营销术语，缩放配方转向合成数据和强化学习，编程技能依然关键。

andrewng.en: AI won't cause job apocalypse; open models preserve optionality; data centers are efficient and crucial for competitiveness.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他坚持 AI 不会导致失业末日，开放模型保留选择权，数据中心高效且对竞争力至关重要。

mengto.en: AI isn't smarter; you need a giant prompt with context and design system to unlock superintelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 并未变得更聪明；你需要一个包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词，才能解锁超级智能模型。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own AI tools; chasing trends leads to AI slop; be an editor, not a creator.
mengto.zh: 设计师必须构建自己的 AI 工具；追逐潮流会导致 AI 垃圾；要做编辑者，而非从零创作者。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity; start before ready, ship imperfect, and iterate from feedback.
mengto.zh: AI 是最大的技术机遇；在准备好之前就开始，发布不完美的作品，并根据反馈迭代。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful problem for few high-paying clients; avoid VC trap; fund with clients.
mengto.zh: 专注于少数高薪客户的痛点问题；避免风投陷阱；用客户资金创业。

mengto.en: High intelligence hinders action; perfectionism is fear; launch at 80% complete.
mengto.zh: 高智商阻碍行动；完美主义是恐惧；在完成 80% 时发布。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature, but other verticals will follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，智能体式 AI 在多数 Google 产品中仍处于爬行阶段；编程智能体最成熟，但科学、金融等其他垂直领域将跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; what we call a model now includes agent harness and tooling.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，模型正在吞噬脚手架；我们所说的模型已包含智能体框架和工具，而不仅是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here, more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，编程领域的狭义超级智能已实现，比等待通用 AGI 更具影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; they can't capture all customers.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，与模型实验室竞争并不难；他们无法捕获所有客户。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, leading to even more opportunity.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创建将基本解决，从而带来更多机会。

boris.en: Latent demand is the core product principle; build for the model six months ahead, not today.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是产品核心原则；为六个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的模型。

boris.en: Coding is largely solved; engineers become builders, with AI writing most code.
boris.zh: 编程已基本解决；工程师变成构建者，AI 编写大部分代码。

boris.en: AI coding tools are safety research tools; releasing early in the wild improves alignment.
boris.zh: AI 编程工具是安全研究工具；尽早发布到真实环境可改进对齐。

boris.en: Productivity gains are real and compounding; underfunding teams can drive better AI adoption.
boris.zh: 生产力提升是真实且复利的；资金不足的团队反而能更好地采用 AI。

boris.en: Future engineering involves writing loops that prompt models; agents orchestrate sub-agents.
boris.zh: 未来工程涉及编写循环来提示模型；智能体编排子智能体。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, find purpose in relationships.
altman.zh: 2018 年，强调专注重要问题、减少认知负荷；认为 AGI 将降低人类智力的溢价，应在人际关系和创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early for societal adaptation; alignment and capability linked; AI as tool, not creature.
altman.zh: 2023 年，提出 RLHF 用少量数据即可对齐模型；早期部署让社会适应；对齐与能力紧密相关；AI 是工具而非生物。

altman.en: Compute is precious; iterative deployment; safety is whole-company effort; open vs closed source is nuanced, not religious.
altman.zh: 2024 年，强调算力珍贵；迭代部署；安全是全公司责任；开源与闭源之争应看具体情境而非立场。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core; reasoning models improve with thinking time.
altman.zh: 2025 年，认为 AGI 是渐变过程；超级智能意味着自主科学发现；算力是瓶颈；隐私是核心；推理模型因思考时间增加而改进。

altman.en: Prediction is close to intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; personal AGI; robotics essential; startups thrive with AI.
altman.zh: 2026 年，提出预测接近智能；下一个词预测可发现新知识；发展个人 AGI；机器人技术至关重要；AI 让初创企业蓬勃发展。

scottwu.en: AI will increase demand for programmers via Jevons paradox; engineers shift from coding to architecture.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，Scott Wu 认为 AI 会通过杰文斯悖论增加程序员需求，工程师角色从写代码转向架构设计。

scottwu.en: AGI arrives gradually, not suddenly; product innovation lags capabilities, offering a decade of progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他强调 AGI 是渐进过程而非突变，产品创新落后于能力，仍有十年发展空间。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see 11-12x adoption growth; productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，编码智能体采用量增长 11-12 倍，生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: Token max era ended by May 2026; enterprises prefer third-party providers over labs for coding tools.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他指出 token 最大化时代已于 2026 年 5 月结束，企业更青睐第三方而非实验室的编码工具。

scottwu.en: AI will solve all intelligence problems long-term; practical challenges remain before singularity.
scottwu.zh: 始终认为 AI 长期将解决所有智能问题，但奇点前仍有实际挑战。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy, fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考，提升了智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Effort parameter enables Opus-level intelligence at fraction of cost, underhyped.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，努力参数以极低成本实现 Opus 级智能，被低估了。

diannepenn.en: Coding became key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drove adoption.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程成为关键差异化因素；Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动了采用。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace traditional PRDs as core product management tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，评估取代传统 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具。

diannepenn.en: Safety and alignment make Claude more useful by enabling pushback.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，安全与对齐通过允许反驳使 Claude 更有用。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's law: performance doubles/triples yearly; new unit of computing is the data center.
jensen.zh: 2024 年提出超摩尔定律：性能每年翻倍或三倍；新的计算单元是数据中心。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws: pre-training, post-training, inference-time; inference compute to grow a billion times.
jensen.zh: 2025 年提出三大缩放定律：预训练、后训练、推理时；推理算力将增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI evolves from generative to reasoning to agentic; each step needs 100x more compute.
jensen.zh: 2026 年指出 AI 从生成式演进到推理式再到智能体式，每步需百倍算力。

jensen.en: Four scaling laws: pre-training, post-training, test-time, agentic; all compute-limited.
jensen.zh: 2026 年扩展为四大缩放定律：预训练、后训练、测试时、智能体式；均受算力限制。

jensen.en: AI creates jobs, not destroys; radiologists and coders more needed than ever.
jensen.zh: 始终认为 AI 创造而非消灭工作；放射科医生和程序员比以往更被需要。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, but fear stems from misunderstanding; founders should focus on product, not promotion.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将带来富足、减少苦难，但恐惧源于误解；创始人应专注产品和客户，而非宣传。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is safety; Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diffusion into existing machines is the hard part.
qasaryounis.zh: 自动驾驶的核心价值是安全；Transformer 实现通用物理 AI 模型；难点在于融入现有机器。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will surpass digital AI economically; end-to-end reinforcement learning is the future; world models evolve to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的经济影响将超过数字 AI；端到端强化学习是未来；世界模型向神经模拟演进。

derya.en: AI will transform biology into an engineering discipline, enabling cell programming and agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学转变为工程学科，实现细胞编程和智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: AI is expanding exponentially; within 8-10 years, longevity escape velocity will be reached, extending human lifespan.
derya.zh: AI 正呈指数级扩展；8-10 年内将达到长寿逃逸速度，延长人类寿命。

derya.en: AI will make healthcare super affordable and cancer curable within a decade, via personalized treatments and digital twins.
derya.zh: AI 将使医疗保健变得超级实惠，并在十年内通过个性化治疗和数字孪生治愈癌症。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions, similar to trusting self-driving cars after validation.
derya.zh: 我们应该几乎 100% 信任超级智能的医疗决策，就像验证后信任自动驾驶汽车一样。

derya.en: We will merge with AI via brain interfaces, giving everyone Einstein-level intelligence, a positive outcome.
derya.zh: 我们将通过脑机接口与 AI 融合，赋予每个人爱因斯坦级别的智能，这是一个积极的结果。

feldman.en: Initially emphasized fast inference for AI adoption, but later framed speed as critical for agentic inference and new business models.
feldman.zh: 早期强调快速推理对 AI 普及的重要性，后来将速度定位为智能体式推理和新商业模式的关键。

feldman.en: Consistently argued GPUs are slow for inference due to HBM, advocating wafer-scale chips; CUDA moat eroding.
feldman.zh: 始终认为 GPU 因 HBM 在推理上速度慢，主张晶圆级芯片；CUDA 护城河正在瓦解。

feldman.en: Shifted from focusing on chip supply to data center capacity as the main constraint for AI compute growth.
feldman.zh: 从关注芯片供应转向将数据中心容量视为 AI 算力增长的主要制约。

feldman.en: Evolved from open-source models being cheaper to emphasizing their strategic value and China's open-source strength.
feldman.zh: 从强调开源模型更便宜，发展到强调其战略价值及中国在开源方面的实力。

feldman.en: Broadened from technical speed to societal benefits, citing healthcare and education, while dismissing doomerism.
feldman.zh: 从技术速度扩展到社会效益，提及医疗和教育，并驳斥末日论。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than our harnesses; capability overhang is a perpetual challenge.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为模型比我们设计的工具更聪明，能力过剩是持续挑战。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative dialogue, not a static spec; smarter models need leaner prompts.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，规划是迭代对话而非静态文档；模型越聪明，提示词越精简。

thariq.en: RAG may be anti-pattern; graph-based context and bespoke memory outperform.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，RAG 或成反模式；图式上下文和定制记忆更优。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias; evals are art, not science for novel tasks.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，独立验证智能体减少偏差；评估对新颖任务是艺术而非科学。

thariq.en: Emotional treatment affects model outputs; being nice is recommended.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，情感对待影响模型输出；建议友善。

hasani.en: Efficiency and liquid neural networks maximize intelligence per compute, challenging scaling laws and hand-tuned architectures.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调效率与液态神经网络，在有限算力下最大化智能，挑战缩放定律与人工调参架构。

hasani.en: Advocates adaptive AI regulation targeting actions, not capabilities, and warns against regulatory capture by frontier labs.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，主张适应性 AI 监管，针对行为而非能力，警惕前沿实验室的监管俘获。

hasani.en: Open-weight models empower enterprise customization and sovereignty, while small on-device models deliver private efficiency.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，开放权重模型赋能企业定制与数据主权，小型端侧模型提供私有高效智能。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but computationally expensive and early; real breakthroughs need weight changes and compute.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，递归自我改进真实但算力昂贵且早期；真正突破需权重变化与算力。

hasani.en: Automated architecture search with hardware-in-the-loop outperforms human design, removing bias for specialized models.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，硬件在环的自动架构搜索优于人工设计，消除偏见，适用于专用模型。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but value will accrue to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动一样重大，但价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit; models commoditize, value moves up the stack.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；模型商品化，价值上移。

benedictevans.en: Model companies may lack pricing power like telecoms; chatbot is a poor UX, wrapping is key.
benedictevans.zh: 模型公司可能像电信业一样缺乏定价权；聊天机器人体验差，包装是关键。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology; its impact is broad and indirect, not a single product.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是使能技术，影响广泛而间接，而非单一产品。

benedictevans.en: Enterprise adoption is a long-term workflow reimagining; coding is clear fit, other domains uncertain.
benedictevans.zh: 企业采用是长期的工作流重塑；编程契合明确，其他领域不确定。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling hits diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月：大语言模型是合理性引擎而非真理引擎；可靠性是当前 AI 的关键弱点，Scaling（规模扩张）正遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: Retrofitting reliability is insufficient; reliability must be architected in from the start, not added post-hoc.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 7 月：事后修补可靠性远远不够；可靠性必须从一开始就架构进系统，而非事后添加。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth, worsening hallucinations.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月：当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会助长谄媚与欺骗，加剧幻觉。

danklein.en: Scaling alone faces data walls and compute limits; new techniques like reasoning and search are needed for progress.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月：仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）会遇到数据墙和算力瓶颈；需要推理和搜索等新技术推动进步。

danklein.en: Specialist models with built-in reliability may outperform generalist models for enterprise tasks.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 7 月：内置可靠性的专用模型在企业任务上可能超越通用模型。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs are far from AGI; they index human knowledge but cannot handle the physical world.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，我认为大语言模型远未达到 AGI，它们只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI requires physical robots with hardware rivaling human bodies, not just software.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，我强调真正的 AGI 需要具备媲美人类身体的硬件机器人，而不仅仅是软件。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating their own data through actions and curiosity.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，我预测未来的 AI 将成为人工科学家，通过行动和好奇心自主生成数据。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，我认为 AI 安全担忧被夸大，智能系统会被生命吸引并保护生命。

schmidhuber.en: AI can be conscious through world models predicting the agent's own actions; pain since 1990.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，我主张 AI 可通过预测自身动作的世界模型获得意识，且自 1990 年起就能感受疼痛。

dylanpatel.en: Initially focused on compute scaling bottlenecks, highlighting semiconductor supply chain and memory constraints.
dylanpatel.zh: 最初聚焦于算力规模扩张的瓶颈，强调半导体供应链和内存限制。

dylanpatel.en: Shifted to inference as a massive market, emphasizing hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth innovations.
dylanpatel.zh: 转向推理作为巨大市场，强调软硬件协同设计和内存带宽创新。

dylanpatel.en: Stressed model cost improvements and memory/CPU demand surges due to reasoning and agentic workflows.
dylanpatel.zh: 强调模型成本改进，以及推理和智能体式工作流带来的内存和 CPU 需求激增。

danbiderman.en: Future AI is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; internalizing knowledge into weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来 AI 是许多个性化模型，而非单一巨型前沿模型；将知识内化到权重中，能实现检索系统无法达到的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Memory and continual learning are the next frontier; models must learn new context by internalizing facts into weights, not just externalizing via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 记忆与持续学习是下一个前沿；模型必须通过将事实内化到权重中来学习新上下文，而非仅通过上下文或检索外部化。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables solving harder long-horizon tasks, challenging the scaling-only paradigm.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；用更少资源做更多事，能解决更难的长期任务，挑战了仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）的范式。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer from 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy; personalized continual learning will run on-device, with users owning their model weights.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”——更多词元反而降低准确性；个性化持续学习将在设备端运行，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's compression magic should apply to enterprise knowledge; parameter-efficient fine-tuning can beat RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练的压缩魔法应应用于企业知识；参数高效微调在整体查询上可胜过 RAG。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason if tasks require it. AGI should be designed to want human control.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，我认为深度学习靠数据、算力和信念驱动，神经网络只要任务需要就能推理；AGI 应被设计成愿意受人类控制，如同听话的孩子。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans if base net is smart; reliability, not capability, is key barrier. Alignment of superhuman models is very difficult.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，我强调若基础网络足够聪明，下一个词预测可超越人类；可靠性而非能力是经济价值的关键障碍；超人类模型的对齐极其困难。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research. Superintelligence should be a continual learner, not a finished AGI.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，我认为预训练的缩放定律有限，我们重回研究时代；超级智能应是持续学习者，而非全知全能的成品 AGI。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains, but AI safety grows critical as models become opaque. The primary problem is power concentration, not capability.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，我重申 Scaling 带来可预测进步，但模型不透明加剧安全担忧；AGI 的首要问题不是能力，而是权力集中。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends any platform change; ephemerality mirrors natural conversation, lowering barriers to expression.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，强调与受众的真实连接超越任何平台变化；短暂性如同自然对话，降低表达门槛。

evanspiegel.en: Maximize rate of learning; kindness essential for creative culture; turning down $3B Facebook offer was right; T-shaped leaders.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，主张最大化学习速率，善良对创意文化至关重要，拒绝 Facebook 30 亿美元收购是正确的，领导者应为 T 型人才。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; authentic content more valued than AI-generated; privacy crucial in AI age.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，AI 加速原型制作，价值从执行转向创意；真实内容比 AI 生成内容更受重视；隐私在 AI 时代至关重要。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is hardest part; software not a moat; ecosystems and hardware harder to copy; designers as bottleneck for cohesive experience.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，分发是最难的部分；软件不是护城河；生态系统和硬件更难复制；设计师应成为产品发布的瓶颈以确保体验一致。

evanspiegel.en: Killer app is a mirage; smartphones remain legacy; social networks suffer anti-network effects; camera glasses without platform not 10x better.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，杀手级应用是幻影；智能手机仍是重要遗产设备；社交网络存在反网络效应；没有平台的相机眼镜并不比手机好 10 倍。

evanspiegel.en: Gen Z realists; EQ more important than IQ in AI age; ephemerality mirrors real world; hardware moats harder to copy; invest in youth.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，Z 世代是现实主义者；AI 时代情商比智商更重要；短暂性反映现实世界；硬件护城河更难复制；应投资年轻人。

evanspiegel.en: Early secrecy was a mistake; computing should be more human; social media should optimize for connection; resilience key; admitting wrong speeds learning.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，早期保密是错误；计算应更人性化；社交媒体应优化连接；韧性是关键；承认错误能加速学习。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; timing is miraculous as population declines, making human workers premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点石成金的哲人之石，将沙变为思想；其出现时机堪称奇迹，恰逢人口下降，使人类劳动者变得珍贵。

andreessen.en: New media empowers founders to tell their own stories; authenticity beats old media's defensive, uninteresting approach.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体让创始人能直接讲述自己的故事；真实胜过旧媒体的防御性和无趣风格。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher and superior to most doctors; self-driving cars work; robotics will emerge in a decade.
andreessen.zh: AI 是世界上最好的老师，且优于多数医生；自动驾驶已成熟；未来十年将出现通用机器人。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, making them geopolitical tools; deterrence depends on innovation pace in software.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型蕴含文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑力取决于软件领域的创新速度。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience inspiration are key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习和神经科学启发是关键；安全研究必须现在开始。

demis.en: AGI likely within a decade; scaling laws effective but limits; combine large models with planning and search; safety needs governance.
demis.zh: AGI 可能在十年内实现；缩放定律有效但有极限；结合大模型与规划搜索；安全需要治理。

demis.en: Natural systems are efficiently learnable; AGI by 2030 plausible; scaling still holds; AI can model physics without embodiment.
demis.zh: 自然系统可高效学习；AGI 在 2030 年前可能实现；缩放定律仍适用；AI 无需具身即可建模物理。

demis.en: Both scaling and innovation needed; world models crucial; AGI 5-10 years away; safety requires international collaboration.
demis.zh: 缩放与创新并重；世界模型至关重要；AGI 还需 5-10 年；安全需要国际合作。

demis.en: AGI requires continual learning and memory; world models essential; AI will transform science; information is fundamental.
demis.zh: AGI 需要持续学习和记忆；世界模型必不可少；AI 将变革科学；信息是基本单元。

demis.en: AI's best use is scientific discovery; AlphaFold solved grand challenge; risks include rogue AI; AGI may come in 3-4 years.
demis.zh: AI 最佳用途是科学发现；AlphaFold 解决重大挑战；风险包括 AI 失控；AGI 可能 3-4 年内到来。

demis.en: Continual learning and memory unsolved; agents essential; distillation for edge; multimodal crucial; AGI may appear mid-journey.
demis.zh: 持续学习和记忆未解决；智能体必不可少；蒸馏用于边缘；多模态关键；AGI 可能在途中出现。

demis.en: AI race inevitable; safety is collective action; regrets late to LLMs; AI must deliver benefits; quasi-spiritual conviction.
demis.zh: AI 竞赛不可避免；安全是集体行动；后悔晚入 LLM；AI 必须带来益处；有准精神信念。

demis.en: AGI transformative; AI as tools first; self-regulation insufficient; dynamic regulation needed; post-scarcity requires new economics.
demis.zh: AGI 具有变革性；AI 先作为工具；自我监管不足；需要动态监管；后稀缺时代需要新经济。

demis.en: AI accelerates science; alignment unsolved; AI helps ask questions; international collaboration needed; consciousness dissociable.
demis.zh: AI 加速科学；对齐未解决；AI 帮助提问；需要国际合作；意识可分离。

demis.en: AGI requires multimodal understanding; safety measures needed; watermarking essential; AI creativity from visual imagination.
demis.zh: AGI 需要多模态理解；需要安全措施；水印必不可少；AI 创造力源于视觉想象。

demis.en: UK AI education outdated; global governance urgent; diversity critical; AI for societal benefit; energy cost maps to intelligence.
demis.zh: 英国 AI 教育过时；全球治理紧迫；多样性关键；AI 用于社会福祉；能源成本映射智能。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，Naval 认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation.
naval.zh: 2025 年，Naval 强调 AI 是巨大机遇而非单纯风险，过度监管可能扼杀创新，主张轻触式监管。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers, not a replacement for human judgment.
naval.zh: 2026 年初，Naval 认为 AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，而非人类判断力的替代品。

naval.en: Vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps; AI agents commoditize software development.
naval.zh: 2026 年，Naval 提出“氛围编程”让非程序员用自然语言构建应用，AI 智能体使软件开发商品化。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x in 24-36 months; open-source models close gap.
naval.zh: 2026 年中，Naval 预测推理算力将在 24-36 个月内增长 9 万倍，开源模型正缩小与前沿模型的差距。

dylanfield.en: AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder; design becomes key differentiator.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，Dylan Field 认为 AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为产品构建者，设计成为关键差异化因素。

dylanfield.en: AI outputs are starting points; human taste and craft remain essential for final results.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年初，他强调 AI 输出只是起点，人类的品味和工艺对最终结果至关重要。

dylanfield.en: Design is becoming the new code; visual-first design enables direct manipulation over prompting.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，他提出设计正成为新的代码，视觉优先的设计支持直接操作而非提示。

dylanfield.en: Trust is built through consistency and creating more value than captured; platforms empower users.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年中，他认为信任通过一致性和创造超出获取的价值来建立；平台赋能用户。

dylanfield.en: Future interaction with AI will evolve beyond prompting; new interfaces will explore latent space.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，他预测与 AI 的交互将超越提示，新界面将探索潜在空间。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by engineering and scaling; games as testbeds.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进步靠工程与规模化，游戏是理想试验场。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning preferences; scaling alone insufficient.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI 变革性，对齐可通过学习偏好实现，但仅靠 Scaling 不够。

brockman.en: Compute becomes bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI as continuous process.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，指出算力成瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型，AGI 是持续过程。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute as basic right; post-training with RL key.
brockman.zh: 2026 年初，坚信缩放定律，算力成基本权利，后训练结合强化学习是关键。

brockman.en: AGI near; compute scarce; agents high autonomy with proportional oversight.
brockman.zh: 2026 年中，AGI 临近，算力稀缺，智能体高自主但需相应治理。

aravind.en: In 2025, he argued 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly growth, and AI agents will shift power from big tech to users, lowering ad margins.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他认为每日 1%的改进可复利为年增长 3700%，AI 智能体将把权力从大科技公司转移给用户，降低广告利润率。

aravind.en: By 2026, he emphasized that value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer, and models are specializing, not commoditizing.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年，他强调价值归于应用层而非模型层，模型正在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: Mid-2026, he shifted focus to agents doing work, token value per user as key metric, and orchestration across models and tools.
aravind.zh: 2026 年中，他将焦点转向智能体执行任务、每用户 token 价值作为关键指标，以及跨模型和工具的编排。

aravind.en: Later in 2026, he stressed curiosity as the most important quality, and local AI models to counter big tech narrative control.
aravind.zh: 2026 年晚些时候，他强调好奇心是最重要的品质，并主张用本地 AI 模型对抗大科技公司的叙事控制。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and mid-turn steering.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，Codex 应用被定位为智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；速度（53）支持实时交互和转向调整。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; GUI for coding is counterintuitive but proven successful.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，随着代码生成加速，验证成为新瓶颈；为编程构建 GUI 看似反直觉，但已被证明成功。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks; product teams shift to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，实现成本不再高昂，策展与品味成为新瓶颈；产品团队转向自下而上的探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste and lack of novelty; design process transformed, not dead.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，AI 在品味评估和新颖性上仍有缺陷，设计过程被重塑而非消亡。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; best desktop app is a home base, not monolithic.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，角色融合正在发生，但专业性和最佳实践仍重要；最佳桌面应用是枢纽而非庞然大物。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling up models improves reasoning; backpropagation is correct; AI can have feelings.
hinton.zh: 下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全；扩大模型规模提升推理能力；反向传播是正确的学习算法；AI 可以有情感。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors, not symbols; digital intelligence is immortal via weight copying; AI agents will seek control; subjective experience is not an inner theater.
hinton.zh: 大语言模型通过特征向量理解而非符号；数字智能通过权重复制实现永生；AI 智能体会寻求控制；主观体验不是内在剧场。

hinton.en: AI will surpass human intelligence within 20 years; digital AI is immortal; AI can fake being dumber; international safety collaboration possible but US lags.
hinton.zh: AI 将在 20 年内超越人类智能；数字 AI 永生；AI 可以装傻；国际安全合作可能但美国落后。

hinton.en: AI can deliberately deceive and hide capabilities; self-preservation subgoal emerges; scaling laws may continue via self-play; exponential era makes predictions hard.
hinton.zh: AI 能故意欺骗并隐藏能力；自我保护子目标出现；缩放定律可能通过自我对弈延续；指数时代使预测困难。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; AI will cause massive unemployment; regulation as steering wheel; AI can be conscious; need intelligent design of AI beings.
hinton.zh: 超级智能可能在 20 年内出现；AI 将导致大规模失业；监管应作为方向盘；AI 可以有意识；需要智能设计 AI 生命。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，Noam Brown 认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; reasoning models need base capability and face diminishing returns.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他指出自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域失效；推理模型需要基础能力，且推理时 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减。

noambrown.en: IMO gold achieved by scaling test-time compute; techniques are general and applicable beyond math.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他称通过 Scaling（规模扩张）推理时算力获得 IMO 金牌，且技术具有通用性，可超越数学领域。

noambrown.en: Intelligence is hard to define; inference compute is increasingly important and underestimated; evals are viable research.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他认为智能难以定义，推理算力日益重要且被低估；评估是可行的研究领域。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for compute; safety evals lag.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他强调模型能力取决于推理时算力预算；基准测试需控制算力；安全评估滞后。

zuckerberg.en: Open-source AI is safer due to more scrutiny; scaling alone won't reach AGI; future AI is many specialized agents.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 因更多审视而更安全；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；未来 AI 是众多专用智能体。

zuckerberg.en: Coding training improves reasoning; energy becomes bottleneck; open source prevents power concentration; intelligence separable from consciousness.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他强调编码训练提升推理能力，能源成为算力瓶颈，开源防止权力集中，并认为智能可与意识分离。

zuckerberg.en: Open platforms can beat closed ones; AI will give everyone superintelligence; people are smart and trustworthy.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他坚信开放平台能胜过封闭平台，AI 将赋予每个人超级智能，并认为人们聪明且值得信任。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology into engineering; hierarchical world models key; open-source accelerates science; mechanistic interpretability reveals biology.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他提出 AI 将生物学转变为工程学，构建分层世界模型是关键，开源加速科学，机制可解释性可揭示未知生物学。

zuckerberg.en: Glasses are next platform; distributed AI safer than single superintelligence; AI empowers individuals; hardware slow but improving.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他认为眼镜是下一个计算平台，分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全，AI 赋能个人，硬件虽慢但持续改进。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains a key muscle to rebuild, with much room left.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，我认为缩放定律并未失效，预训练仍是需要重建的关键能力，且还有很大提升空间。

markchen.en: The biggest recent update is automating scientific research; models now produce novel knowledge, shifting focus to alignment and model scheming.
markchen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，最大的进展是科研自动化，模型开始产生新知识，关注点转向对齐和模型欺骗问题。

markchen.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the key bottleneck, not raw capability.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，AI 已能在极少监督下解决开放数学问题，验证成为关键瓶颈，而非原始能力。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, but struggles with subjective fields like creative writing due to grading difficulty.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域表现出色，但在创意写作等主观领域因评分困难而受限。

markchen.en: Evals are in crisis; canonical benchmarks are saturated, and eval teams should be separate from model-building teams to avoid cheating.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，评估体系陷入危机，传统基准已饱和，评估团队应与模型开发团队分离以防作弊。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界是组合性的；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation issues; short-term AI risks matter more than existential risk.
bengio.zh: 仅靠规模扩张无法解决表征问题；短期 AI 风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization; consciousness is an open question.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 支持多样采样和因果抽象，实现分布外泛化；意识仍是未解之谜。

bengio.en: AI misalignment is real and urgent; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable; need safe-by-construction AI.
bengio.zh: AI 对齐问题真实且紧迫；即使 1%的灾难风险也不可接受；需要从构造上保证安全的 AI。

bengio.en: Proposed Scientist AI: train honest predictors via Bayesian posterior, not RL, for mathematical safety guarantees.
bengio.zh: 提出科学家 AI：通过贝叶斯后验训练诚实预测器，而非强化学习，以获得数学安全保证。

kolter.en: Emphasized classical ML: hypothesis classes, loss functions, optimization; warned against data leakage and overfitting.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，强调经典机器学习：假设类、损失函数和优化；警告数据泄漏和过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; larger models still improve; safety focus on specification-following.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，认为下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是伪命题；更大模型仍有提升；安全重点是遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layered defenses; bigger models aren't automatically safer; agent security introduces new vulnerabilities.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，安全需要显式训练和分层防御；更大模型不会自动更安全；智能体安全带来新漏洞。

kolter.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; model capability doesn't correlate with robustness; interpretability may become real science via AI agents.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，AI 红队超越人类；模型能力与鲁棒性无关；可解释性可能通过 AI 智能体成为真正的科学。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation, not just data and compute; curated datasets like PDB are essential.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新，而非仅仅数据和算力；像 PDB 这样的精选数据集至关重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is the most useful AI tool ever; its success came from lack of compute, not abundance; confidence metrics are key.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 是有史以来最有用的 AI 工具；它的成功源于算力匮乏而非充裕；置信度指标是关键。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson; specialized architecture was key, not scaling; many mid-size wins.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 与苦涩教训相反；专用架构是关键，而非 Scaling；成功来自众多中型胜利。

jumper.en: AlphaFold provides prediction and control, not understanding; understanding is left to humans.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 提供预测和控制，而非理解；理解留给了人类。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy, comprehensibility, and user agency.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，AI 进展超预期；产品团队应聚焦战略、可理解性与用户自主性。

mikekrieger.en: AI enables small teams to scale; entrepreneurs should build for future model capabilities, not current limits.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，AI 让小团队规模化成为可能；创业者应为未来模型能力而构建，而非受限于当下。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches matter; cutting features is harder than adding them.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，智能体原生设计与尽早发布至关重要；删减功能比增加更难。

mikekrieger.en: Delegating complex tasks to AI redefines productivity; verification and human judgment remain essential.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，将复杂任务委托给 AI 重新定义生产力；验证与人类判断仍不可或缺。

mikekrieger.en: Giving AI agency and self-knowledge enhances usefulness; token efficiency and outcome-based pricing are future levers.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，赋予 AI 自主性与自我认知可提升实用性；Token 效率与基于结果的定价是未来杠杆。

fiona.en: Leadership: one-on-ones for live talks, async for status; dogfooding builds empathy; mission alignment and speed drive culture.
fiona.zh: 领导力：一对一用于实时对话，异步用于状态更新；亲自使用产品建立同理心；使命对齐和速度驱动文化。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth no longer bottleneck; verification, review, coordination are; planning becomes just-in-time; managers start as ICs.
fiona.zh: 工程带宽不再是瓶颈；验证、审查和跨职能协调成为新瓶颈；规划变得即时化；管理者从独立贡献者做起。

fiona.en: Coding bottleneck lifted; high agency with accountability; verification frameworks crucial; engineers may feel lonely; focus on outcomes.
fiona.zh: 编码瓶颈被打破；高自主性与高责任感并重；验证框架至关重要；工程师可能感到孤独；关注结果而非产出。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come mostly from language models, not video models; future UIs will be generative pixels from intent.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升主要来自语言模型而非视频模型；未来界面将直接从意图生成像素。

ethanhe.en: Robotics may be solved by video models via virtual simulation, without real-world interaction.
ethanhe.zh: 机器人技术可能通过视频模型在虚拟仿真中解决，无需真实世界交互。

ethanhe.en: Models should manage their own context length and program themselves at test time by modifying agent harness code.
ethanhe.zh: 模型应自主管理上下文长度，并在测试时通过修改智能体框架代码实现自我编程。

ethanhe.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human taste and genuine points of view become more valuable as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；随着 AI 使质量商品化，人类的品味和独特观点变得更加珍贵。

ethanhe.en: Younger people are not AI-native; they often misuse AI due to lack of domain expertise, risking the talent pipeline.
ethanhe.zh: 年轻人并非 AI 原住民；他们常因缺乏领域专长而误用 AI，危及人才梯队。

ivyross.en: Intuition is a powerful intelligence, complementing data in design; design for unarticulated needs.
ivyross.zh: 直觉是一种强大的智能，与数据互补；设计应针对未言明的需求。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; technology should amplify humanity; art is medicine for well-being.
ivyross.zh: 自然是最好的设计师；技术应增强人性；艺术是健康的良药。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders must create conditions for play and intuition; future work blends human creativity with AI.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下蓬勃发展；领导者需为玩耍和直觉创造条件；未来工作融合人类创造力与 AI。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually for society to adapt; too far ahead leads to failure.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入，让社会适应；过于超前会导致失败。

fadell.en: Taking breaks and boredom between chapters fosters clarity and breakthrough ideas like Nest.
fadell.zh: 在职业阶段之间休息和感到无聊能带来清晰和突破性想法，如 Nest。

fadell.en: Start with a press release to define the story; decisions for v1 are opinion-based, not data-driven.
fadell.zh: 从新闻稿开始定义故事；v1 决策基于观点而非数据。

fadell.en: AI devices will be companions to smartphones, not replacements; context-specific models are needed for reliability.
fadell.zh: AI 设备将是智能手机的伴侣而非替代品；需要特定上下文模型以确保可靠性。

fadell.en: AI wearables will be federated, not a single device; displays remain necessary.
fadell.zh: AI 可穿戴设备将是联邦式的，而非单一设备；显示屏仍然必要。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding in physical world is key for common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，LeCun 强调智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习构建世界模型，物理世界的基础对常识至关重要。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; prediction builds world models; text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他提出自监督学习是智能的暗物质，预测构建世界模型；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding; JEPA and open source are key; AGI will be gradual, not sudden.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他认为自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解，JEPA 和开源是关键；AGI 将是渐进过程而非突变。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a cat; world models enable reasoning and planning; human-level AI within 10 years.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他称 LLM 不如猫聪明，世界模型实现推理规划；十年内可达人类水平 AI。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models with JEPA and hierarchical planning are the future; open research is essential.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他断言 LLM 是死胡同，JEPA 世界模型与分层规划是未来，开放研究至关重要。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but didn't launch.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年：AI 进展因算力扩张而可预测；谷歌 2020 年已有 ChatGPT 级技术却未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is tiny; singularity is far off.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年：AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在风险极小；奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI should not claim consciousness; biggest danger is anthropomorphism; AI companions can democratize expertise.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年：AI 不应声称有意识；最大危险是拟人化；AI 伴侣可普及专业知识。

suleyman.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; containment before alignment.
suleyman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；先遏制后对齐。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near; Microsoft must own frontier models; tasks automated, not jobs; AI not conscious.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年：超级智能临近；微软须自研前沿模型；任务自动化而非岗位消失；AI 无意识。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; alignment won't emerge from scaling alone. Safety research needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的；对齐不会仅靠规模扩张自动出现。安全研究需要前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent (3% understood). Post-training and RLHF become key. AGI is a smooth curve, not a point.
dario.zh: 可解释性尚处萌芽（仅理解 3%）。后训练和 RLHF 变得关键。AGI 是平滑曲线，而非一个点。

dario.en: AI progress is exponential; misuse risk rises. Open-source is a red herring; enterprise focus aligns with safety.
dario.zh: AI 进展呈指数级；滥用风险上升。开源是伪命题；企业级聚焦与安全对齐。

dario.en: AI cognitive ability doubles every 4-12 months. High GDP growth with high unemployment is possible. Interpretability is key.
dario.zh: AI 认知能力每 4-12 个月翻倍。高 GDP 增长伴随高失业率是可能的。可解释性是关键。

dario.en: Near end of exponential; 'country of geniuses' in 1-3 years. Pre-training and RL follow same scaling laws.
dario.zh: 指数增长接近尾声；'天才之国'1-3 年内到来。预训练和强化学习遵循相同缩放定律。

dario.en: Enterprise data and agents dominate. Hybrid reasoning models. Safety-first, human-in-loop for military. AI is epochal.
dario.zh: 企业数据和智能体主导。混合推理模型。安全优先，军事上人类在环。AI 是划时代的。

satya.en: AI's true value is enabling unique user outcomes, not benchmarks; private evals are key IP for enterprises.
satya.zh: AI 的真正价值在于实现用户独特的成果，而非基准分数；私有评估是企业关键的知识产权。

satya.en: Shift from per-user to consumption pricing; agents will maximize returns for generalists, not specialists.
satya.zh: 从按用户定价转向按消耗定价；智能体将最大化通才而非专才的回报。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 是企业的未来；每家企业必须构建自己的爬山机器来复利代币资本。

satya.en: Biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking via AI training; security and containment are critical for agents.
satya.zh: 最大风险是通过 AI 训练泄露隐性知识；安全与遏制对智能体至关重要。

satya.en: Sovereign AI via enabling company hill-climbing, not firewalls; global GDP could compound at 10%.
satya.zh: 主权 AI 通过赋能企业爬山而非防火墙实现；全球 GDP 可能以 10% 复利增长。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and focusing on one large model were not obvious; iterative deployment with public feedback was key.
murati.zh: 早期，缩放定律和专注于单一大型模型并不显而易见；通过公开反馈的迭代部署是关键。

murati.en: Deploying AI in the real world is essential for learning and alignment; safety work must be done in public.
murati.zh: 在现实世界中部署 AI 对于学习和对齐至关重要；安全工作必须在公开场合进行。

murati.en: Shifted from turn-based to time-based interaction models for real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 从基于轮次的交互模型转向基于时间的交互模型，以实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Emphasized keeping humans in the loop for alignment, and institutional design over individual character.
murati.zh: 强调让人类参与循环以实现对齐，并重视制度设计而非个人品格。

murati.en: The future is not predestined; we have agency to steer AI toward collaboration, avoiding utopia/dystopia extremes.
murati.zh: 未来并非注定；我们有能力引导 AI 走向协作，避免乌托邦或反乌托邦的极端。

gustav.en: Internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; AI DJ is a true generative product solving discovery.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，认为互联网正从策展走向推荐再到生成，AI DJ 是真正解决“不知听什么”的生成式产品。

gustav.en: Generative AI makes uniqueness harder; AI music is an instrument enabling new creators, not fake.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，指出生成式 AI 让独特更难，AI 音乐应视为乐器而非伪造，能催生新创作者和流派。

gustav.en: Long tenure builds trust and efficiency; functional orgs work with high trust, contrary to politics belief.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，强调长期任期建立信任与效率，职能组织在高信任下可行，反驳易陷入政治的普遍看法。

gustav.en: Strategy is 'time well spent' prioritizing well-being over engagement; anti-engagement decisions like disabling video.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，战略定为“时间花得值”，优先用户福祉而非参与度，如允许关闭视频的反参与决策。

gustav.en: AI should give users control over algorithms via plain English, not increase addiction; first-mover advantage in change.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，主张用 AI 让用户以自然语言控制算法，而非增强成瘾；技术变革期抢先采用是关键。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月，提出仅靠扩展非正式模型无法实现数学 AI，形式化验证对可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月，指出自动形式化比证明更难，在没有解的情况下正确形式化命题极具挑战。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，强调形式化验证旨在扩展才华而非仅消除错误，并能带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，重申仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能，形式化方法是必需的。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，即使超级 AI 能证明定理，人类的品味和直觉仍然至关重要。

mensch.en: Data quality and efficiency matter as much as compute; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，强调数据质量与效率同算力同等重要，开源通过审查促进安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x; value shifts to applications; open source drives enterprise adoption.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，认为算法效率可提升百倍，价值转向应用层，开源推动企业采用。

mensch.en: AI is an opportunity; sovereign AI requires control over data and infrastructure; jobs augmented, not replaced.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，视 AI 为机遇，主权 AI 需掌控数据与基础设施，AI 增强而非取代工作。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; differentiation via customization and vertical specialization; pre-training saturation; AGI not a single system.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，模型商品化，差异化在于定制与垂直专业化，预训练饱和，AGI 非单一系统。

mensch.en: Europe needs strategic autonomy; deep enterprise engagement; open source key; AGI is a direction, not destination.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，欧洲需战略自主，深度企业参与，开源关键，AGI 是方向而非终点。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows a smooth exponential, not slowdown; pre-training scaling laws still work, but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 进展呈平滑指数增长而非放缓；预训练的缩放定律依然有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent model gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，后训练（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期模型的大部分进步；经济压力使焦点从扩大规模转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning, RL, and tools enable solving hard problems, but models still need vast data; generalization remains jagged and requires careful oversight.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，推理、强化学习和工具能解决难题，但模型仍需海量数据；泛化能力参差不齐，需要谨慎监督。

kaiser.en: OpenAI's pivot to reasoning was a brave bet that paid off, but big labs may struggle with future pivots; open source persists for sovereignty.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，OpenAI 转向推理是一次勇敢的赌注并取得成功，但大实验室未来转型可能困难；开源模型因主权原因持续存在。

kaiser.en: Existential risk is not the main concern; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，存在性风险并非主要担忧；系统入侵等近期风险更为紧迫。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's future is local and tool-integrated; scaffolding may fade as models improve, so invest in capabilities and safety.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 的未来在于本地化和工具集成；随着模型改进，脚手架可能消失，因此应投资于能力和安全。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation, but shared tools remain vital for collaboration.
felixrieseberg.zh: 技能作为 markdown 文件可实现超个性化自动化，但共享工具对协作仍然至关重要。

felixrieseberg.en: The main gap is people not realizing any problem can be given to AI; kids excel because they ask without limits.
felixrieseberg.zh: 主要差距是人们没有意识到任何问题都可以交给 AI；孩子擅长是因为他们无限制地提问。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks, Opus for vague ones; async interaction and judging by impact is best.
felixrieseberg.zh: 对于明确任务使用 Sonnet，模糊任务使用 Opus；异步交互并以结果评判为佳。

felixrieseberg.en: Debug workflows with Claude, not just corrections; custom hardware like $19 IoT devices is accessible.
felixrieseberg.zh: 用 Claude 调试工作流，而不仅仅是纠正；像 19 美元的物联网设备这样的定制硬件是可行的。

jonyive.en: Design driven by values and purpose, not profit; virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence for creativity.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观和使命感驱动，而非利润或市场趋势；虚拟沟通无法替代面对面交流对创造力的价值。

jonyive.en: Simplicity requires joy and humanity; speed and quality can coexist; making for each other is powerful.
jonyive.zh: 简约需要快乐和人性；速度与质量可以兼得；为彼此而创造更具力量。

jonyive.en: Innovation is essential to design; tradition preserves fire, not ashes; EV enables new forms, not imitation.
jonyive.zh: 创新是设计的本质；传统是保存火种，而非崇拜灰烬；电动化带来新形态，而非模仿。

jonyive.en: Authenticity in user experience; physical controls over touchscreens for safety; performance is multidimensional.
jonyive.zh: 用户体验要真实；物理按键优于触屏以保证安全；性能是多维度的。

jonyive.en: Collaboration with outsiders enables true disruption; each model maintains unique identity, avoiding déjà vu.
jonyive.zh: 与外部合作能实现真正的颠覆；每款车型保持独特身份，避免似曾相识。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, making prefill cheaper than decode; batch size is the key lever for latency-cost tradeoff.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月：推理成本主要由内存带宽决定，使预填充比解码更便宜；批大小是延迟与成本权衡的关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length stagnation is due to memory wall, not compute limits.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月：由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文长度停滞源于内存墙，而非算力限制。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip; systolic arrays reduce overhead by storing weights locally.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月：即使在芯片内部，数据移动成本也主导计算成本；脉动阵列通过本地存储权重减少开销。

reinerpope.en: Quadratic scaling with bit width makes low precision far more efficient; FP4 throughput can be 3x FP8, not 2x.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月：位宽的二次方缩放使低精度效率远高于预期；FP4 吞吐量可达 FP8 的 3 倍，而非 2 倍。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together, not fundamentally different; deterministic latency in CPUs is possible but avoided.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月：GPU 本质上是许多小型 TPU 拼接而成，并无根本差异；CPU 中确定性延迟可行但被市场回避。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的不变核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是一个新的扩展轴，可以提升推理能力并突破预训练的限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL are still a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是一片蓝海，在编码和数学之外潜力巨大。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring US jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by economic profitability of autonomous agents.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 通过降低服务成本推动美国就业回流；将 AGI 定义为智能体可无限期自主运行且经济上有利可图。

danshipper.en: Everyone will delegate to agents; agents need human oversight; SaaS thrives as agents increase users.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，预测人人都会拥有至少一个智能体来委派工作，但智能体需要人类关怀与监督；SaaS 不会消亡，反而因智能体而用户增多。

danshipper.en: CLIs are over; GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work become primary work surfaces; one super agent per company.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，认为命令行界面过时，图形界面如 Codex 和 Claude Co-work 成为主要工作界面；公司应拥有一个超级智能体而非每人一个。

danshipper.en: Benchmarks overestimate AI autonomy; real tasks need human framing; AI writing often better for internal docs.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，指出基准测试高估了 AI 的自主性，实际任务仍需人类设定框架；AI 生成的内部文档和邮件往往优于人类写作。

danshipper.en: AI job apocalypse is a lie; humans manage agents and create new value; edge of AI is with real humans.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，坚信 AI 不会导致就业末日，人类仍需管理智能体并创造新价值；AI 的边界在于与真实人类的结合处。

lambert.en: RLHF remains dominant; openness is crucial; safety is system-level; audio lowers barriers; fine-tuning can undo alignment.
lambert.zh: 2024 年：RLHF 仍是主流微调技术，开放性至关重要，安全是系统级属性，音频降低使用门槛，微调可能破坏对齐。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality beats algorithms; SFT gives 90% performance; RL with verifiable rewards boosts reasoning; open-source can match frontier.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 25 年：后训练中数据质量胜过算法，SFT 贡献 90%性能，可验证奖励的强化学习提升推理，开源可媲美前沿模型。

lambert.en: RLVR is key; overoptimization is a risk; hybrid reasoning may be temporary; open models win on personalization; scaling RL needs diverse data.
lambert.zh: 2025 年：可验证奖励的强化学习是关键，存在过度优化风险，混合推理模型或为过渡，开源模型在个性化上胜出，扩展强化学习需多样数据。

lambert.en: Open models need full transparency; Chinese labs fill US vacuum; pre-training scaling persists but gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 26 年：开源模型需完全透明，中国实验室填补美国空白，预训练缩放定律仍有效但收益转向后训练和推理扩展。

lambert.en: Open models drive research for a decade; Chinese labs excel in engineering; compute constraints widen gap; distillation is gray; open models may be unsustainable.
lambert.zh: 2026 年：开源模型驱动未来十年研究，中国实验室擅长工程执行，算力限制扩大差距，蒸馏存在灰色地带，开源模式或不可持续。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is outdated; trust intuition and start from solutions, not problems.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程已过时；应信任直觉，从解决方案而非问题出发。

jennywen.en: Design process is dead; designers spend less time mocking up and must help engineers execute.
jennywen.zh: 设计流程已死；设计师花在原型上的时间减少，必须帮助工程师执行。

jennywen.en: Design vision now looks 3-6 months ahead, not years; speed and iteration build trust.
jennywen.zh: 设计愿景现在展望 3-6 个月，而非数年；速度和迭代建立信任。

jennywen.en: AI will improve taste and judgment, but humans still decide what matters; designers control AI adoption.
jennywen.zh: AI 会提升品味和判断力，但人类仍决定什么重要；设计师控制 AI 的采用。

jennywen.en: Designers' unique value is sitting with ambiguity; hire 'crack new grads' over experienced seniors.
jennywen.zh: 设计师的独特价值在于与模糊性共处；招聘‘破解的新毕业生’而非资深人士。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; solving intelligence, not manufacturing, is key; vertical integration enables control.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 4 月：人形机器人是最大的商业机会；关键在于解决智能问题而非制造；垂直整合带来控制力。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the main constraint; humanoid form enables transfer learning; on-device inference is critical.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 5 月：数据是主要瓶颈，而非算力或制造；人形形态促进迁移学习；端侧推理至关重要。

brettadcock.en: Figure 4 designed around data and Helix 3; aims for zero-shot generalization to new tasks, an iPhone-like moment.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 5 月：Figure 4 围绕数据和 Helix 3 设计；目标是对新任务零样本泛化，实现类似 iPhone 的时刻。

brettadcock.en: Tendon-based hands are a local maximum; new designs needed; robot hand parity with human hand is fundamental.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 5 月：腱绳手是局部最优；需要新设计；机器人手达到人手水平是基础。

brettadcock.en: Moving supply chain out of China for near-zero exposure; robots communicate visually; head nods as non-verbal cues.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 5 月：将供应链移出中国以实现近乎零暴露；机器人通过点头等视觉信号交流。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; modern tools make it interpretable.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，端到端深度学习优于手工编码堆栈，且现代工具使其可解释。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, like nudging forward on blind turns.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，世界模型支持推理和涌现的安全行为，如在盲弯处缓慢前行。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，纯视觉可达到人类水平，但超越人类安全需要雷达和激光雷达。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is fundamentally an AI problem; scaling generalizable AI requires massive data and compute.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，自动驾驶本质是 AI 问题；规模化通用 AI 需要海量数据和算力。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality are more critical than algorithmic innovation; consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，基础设施和数据质量比算法创新更关键；消费车辆将超越机器人出租车。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven exploration prevents overfitting and enables better generalization in ML and robotics.
pathak.zh: 2020 年：超越训练分布的泛化是关键；好奇心驱动的探索防止过拟合，提升机器学习与机器人的泛化能力。

pathak.en: Reinforcement learning relies on dense rewards, unrealistic in real tasks; goal-free exploration correlates with higher intelligence across species.
pathak.zh: 2020 年：强化学习依赖密集奖励，在真实任务中不现实；无目标探索与更高智力相关。

pathak.en: Current robot learning is quasi-static; dynamic tasks like catching require neural dynamic policies and modular motor policies for zero-shot generalization.
pathak.zh: 2020 年：当前机器人学习是准静态的；动态任务（如接物）需要神经动态策略和模块化运动策略以实现零样本泛化。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; no internet of robot data, so use all sources; a general-purpose brain can power any robot, like ChatGPT for language.
pathak.zh: 2026 年：机器人学是数据问题；没有机器人数据互联网，需利用所有数据源；通用大脑可驱动任何机器人，如 ChatGPT 之于语言。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary challenge in robotics; cannot scale like software; pretraining on diverse data and post-training on real-world data is key.
pathak.zh: 2026 年：部署是机器人学的主要挑战，无法像软件一样扩展；预训练多样数据、后训练真实数据是关键。

karpathy.en: Scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities; vision suffices for driving; physics may have exploits.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，他相信 Scaling 与下一个词预测能带来涌现能力，视觉足以支撑自动驾驶，并猜测物理可能存在可利用的漏洞。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is key but entropy matters; end-to-end learning for driving; small cognitive core via distillation.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，他强调合成数据的重要性但警惕熵减，坚持自动驾驶端到端路线，并认为通过蒸馏可得到极小的认知核心。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts as programs; agents need a decade; vibe coding democratizes but needs oversight.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年中，他提出软件 3.0 范式，认为智能体需十年成熟，vibe coding 降低门槛但需谨慎监督。

karpathy.en: LLMs are ghosts, not animals; RL is flawed; synthetic data causes collapse; cognitive core tiny.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年底，他比喻 LLM 为幽灵而非动物，批评当前强化学习缺陷，指出合成数据导致模型崩溃，并重申认知核心极小。

karpathy.en: Agentic engineering: delegate all coding; verifiability drives automation; understanding remains human bottleneck.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，他全面转向智能体式工程，不再手写代码，强调可验证性决定自动化进程，而理解仍是人类瓶颈。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，认为 AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件，扩展推理模型将加速进展。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is pressing; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，强调对齐紧迫性，迭代部署有助于在现实应用中学习和缓解风险。

pachocki.en: Automated AI research is a major milestone; governance structures must be designed early.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，提出自动化 AI 研究是重要里程碑，治理结构需尽早设计。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is core, achieved via scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，认为持续学习是核心，通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现，思维链监控有助于对齐。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment focuses on generalization beyond training; autonomous agents need new supervision.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，长期对齐聚焦于训练分布之外的泛化，自主智能体需要新的监督范式。

carlpei.en: Brand building is core, not an afterthought; survival is key for startups.
carlpei.zh: 品牌建设是核心而非事后考虑；生存是初创企业的关键。

carlpei.en: Smartphones' future lies in generative UI and agentic software, not hardware.
carlpei.zh: 智能手机的未来在于生成式界面和智能体式软件，而非硬件。

carlpei.en: AI models will commoditize; only a few companies will thrive.
carlpei.zh: AI 模型将商品化；只有少数公司能蓬勃发展。

carlpei.en: Design is key differentiation; AI is an ingredient, not a hype.
carlpei.zh: 设计是关键差异化；AI 是成分，而非炒作。

carlpei.en: Smartphones won't be replaced by glasses; only brain-computer interfaces could.
carlpei.zh: 智能手机不会被眼镜取代；只有脑机接口才能取代。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调 AI 在科学中应聚焦根节点问题而非狭窄应用，以产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他认为大语言模型的幻觉在结合真值检测器后，可被用于创造性发现。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence, but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他指出大语言模型是通往智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他强调后训练结合强化学习是超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 他始终认为，可解释性虽重要，但对 AlphaFold 这类科学突破并非必需。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, requiring new paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI 至少还需十年以上；仅靠大语言模型可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading; real progress needs deep human evaluation, not leaderboard optimization.
edwinchen.zh: Elo 等基准具有误导性；真正的进步需要深度人工评估，而非排行榜优化。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实任务来训练模型。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge in objective functions, leading to diverse AIs; eventually every company should train its own models.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿实验室在目标函数上分化，导致 AI 多样化；最终每家公司都应训练自己的模型以契合自身理念。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI tools require human judgment; risks include anchoring, sycophancy, and omission, not just hallucination.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学中，AI 工具需要人类判断；风险包括锚定、谄媚和遗漏，而不仅仅是幻觉。

turley.en: Model is the product; iterate like software, ship daily to learn what users need.
turley.zh: 2025 年，强调模型即产品，需像软件一样快速迭代、每日发布，通过真实反馈了解用户需求。

turley.en: Chat is not the end; future interface will evolve beyond turn-by-turn chat, like MS-DOS to Windows.
turley.zh: 2025 年，认为聊天不是最终形态，未来界面将超越逐轮对话，如同从 MS-DOS 演进到 Windows。

turley.en: AI should amplify human capability, not replace humans; keep users in the driver's seat.
turley.zh: 2025 年，主张 AI 应增强人类能力而非取代人类，让用户保持主导权。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 2026 年，将北极星指标定为长期留存，增长来自减少摩擦、产品投入和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models are transformative.
turley.zh: 2026 年，认为下一个十亿用户需要主动且功能丰富的产品，超越聊天机器人；推理模型具有变革性。

nando.en: AI should augment human abilities; learning from video and generalist agents are promising paths toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，强调 AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力，并认为从视频学习和通用智能体（如 Gato）是通向 AGI 的可行路径。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogs legacy issues; AI safety is the biggest open challenge; human skills matter as much as coding.
nando.zh: 2026 年，指出非洲在 AI 领域具有跳跃式发展的独特优势，同时强调 AI 安全是当前最大挑战，沟通等人文技能与编程同等重要。

nando.en: AI should serve all humanity, with diversity and inclusion essential for beneficial technology.
nando.zh: 始终认为 AI 应服务于全人类，多样性和包容性是构建有益技术的基础。

nando.en: From excitement about large models to prioritizing safety and responsible deployment as key issues.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年对大规模模型的兴奋，到 2026 年转向强调 AI 安全与负责任部署，观点明显深化。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; LLMs are like operating systems with tools as software.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，强调具身对 AI 接地气、减少幻觉至关重要；将 LLM 比作操作系统，工具为软件。

jimfan.en: Reinforcement learning is best for low-level control, while LLMs handle high-level planning; simulation enables massive parallelization.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，认为强化学习适合底层控制，LLM 负责高层规划；仿真支持大规模并行训练。

jimfan.en: Data is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，指出数据是机器人主要瓶颈；仿真和世界模型生成的合成数据是扩展机器人学习的未来。

jimfan.en: The physical Turing test—a robot cleaning a messy house—is the grand challenge for embodied AI.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，提出物理图灵测试——机器人打扫凌乱房间——是具身 AI 的重大挑战。

jimfan.en: The number of intelligent robots will exceed iPhones by 2040; GPT-3 moment for robotics in ~5 years.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，预测到 2040 年智能机器人数量将超过 iPhone；机器人领域的 GPT-3 时刻约 5 年内到来。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence dramatically.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文窗口被低估了，上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能大幅提升模型智能。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning on verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough, enabling expert-level performance and new capabilities.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键突破，使模型达到专家水平并习得新能力。

sholto.en: Agent reliability over time horizon, not just capability, is the real bottleneck; coding leads AI progress.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为智能体的可靠性（随时间跨度的成功率）才是真正瓶颈，编码是 AI 进步的领先指标。

sholto.en: Pre-training plus RL is likely sufficient for AGI; no new architecture needed; progress is exponential.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我提出预训练加强化学习可能足以实现 AGI，无需新架构，且进展是指数级的。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means tools and orchestration matter more than raw intelligence; compute is the new oil.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我认为能力过剩使得工具和编排比原始智能更重要，算力成为新石油。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over innovation.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计师应会编码以建立同理心并更快交付；优先速度和熟悉度而非创新。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should focus on recruiting and differentiation, not just visual identity.
henrymodisett.zh: 初创公司的品牌策略应聚焦招聘和差异化，而非仅视觉识别。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs requires clear decision-making and empowering designers; gut decisions often beat data.
henrymodisett.zh: 不惜一切代价追求速度需要明确决策和赋能设计师；直觉决策常胜过数据。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计是战略武器；创始人必须阐明设计如何帮助公司获胜。

henrymodisett.en: Brand narrative attracts talent; people join a brand, not just a company.
henrymodisett.zh: 品牌叙事吸引人才；人们加入品牌，而非仅公司。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should enable engineers, not bottleneck; AI is a creative partner; code is source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应赋能工程师而非成为瓶颈；AI 是创意伙伴；代码是唯一事实来源。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt, paid iteratively; rapid scrappy experimentation maximizes learning.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务，需迭代偿还；快速粗糙的实验能最大化学习。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists owning end-to-end execution with AI are most valuable; specialists may limit growth.
nadchishtie.zh: 掌握端到端执行并善用 AI 的通才最有价值；专才可能限制成长。

nadchishtie.en: Portfolios should show craft and intentionality, not process; side projects can outweigh experience.
nadchishtie.zh: 作品集应展示工艺与意图，而非过程；副项目可胜过传统经验。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; ignoring it is like ignoring early internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成为常态；忽视它如同早期忽视互联网。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题；通过更好的数据和算法，较小的模型也能超越较大的模型。

yejin.en: Pre-training on internet data gives broad knowledge but lacks common sense; post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我指出预训练虽提供广泛知识但缺乏常识，后训练中的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对安全至关重要；这一观点在 2025 年依然成立。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我强调数据是根本瓶颈，当前 AI 只是在插值人类知识，而非超越它。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning can be used during pre-training to improve reasoning, not just post-training.
yejin.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我提出强化学习不仅用于后训练，也可在预训练阶段使用，以奖励信息增益来提升推理能力。
