yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment respects diverse human values; frontier models show homogeneity, so small models with diverse data can be powerful.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我主张多元对齐以尊重多样的人类价值观；前沿模型存在同质性，而使用多样化数据的小模型可以变得强大。

brettaylor.en: AI market shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; frontier models dominated by hyperscalers; startups focus on applied AI agents.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：AI 市场转向智能体和基于结果的定价；前沿模型由超大规模企业主导；初创企业聚焦应用型 AI 智能体。

brettaylor.en: Future programming languages prioritize verifiability for AI generation; coding agents often produce incorrect code, requiring root-cause analysis.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：未来编程语言优先考虑可验证性以适应 AI 生成；编码智能体常产生错误代码，需进行根本原因分析。

brettaylor.en: AI agents for customer experience become as important as websites; outcome-based pricing aligns value with business outcomes.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：用于客户体验的 AI 智能体变得与网站同等重要；基于结果的定价使价值与业务成果对齐。

brettaylor.en: Inference costs drop dramatically, enabling new use cases; software engineering agents shift developers from authors to operators.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：推理成本大幅下降，催生新用例；软件工程智能体使开发者从作者转变为操作者。

brettaylor.en: AI agents will be compared to agents, not humans; incumbents face business model challenges; generalists outperform specialists.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：AI 智能体将与其他智能体而非人类比较；现有企业面临商业模式挑战；通才胜过专才。

leike.en: AI safety needs empirical research; focus on alignment and robustness. PhD in ML is the path.
leike.zh: 2018 年，强调 AI 安全需要实证研究，聚焦对齐与鲁棒性，博士是成为安全研究者的路径。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; use scalable oversight and interpretability to align superintelligence.
leike.zh: 2023 年，认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需用可扩展监督和可解释性来对齐超级智能。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training insufficient; need external oversight.
leike.zh: 2024 年，指出 OpenAI 安全文化衰退，后训练不足以解决对齐，需外部监管。

truell.en: Initially, natural language is not the primary programming method; examples and direct manipulation are better, and local models are not the future.
truell.zh: 2024 年，认为自然语言并非主要编程方式，示例和直接操作更好，且本地模型不是未来方向。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict progress; test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as the next major driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年，相信缩放定律预测进展，但测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练缩放成为下一主要驱动力。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to intent specification; taste and logic design become more valuable than carefulness.
truell.zh: 2025 年，编程从代码转向意图描述，品味和逻辑设计比细心更有价值。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality; every magic moment in Cursor involves a custom model.
truell.zh: 2025 年，定制模型对产品质量至关重要；Cursor 中每个神奇时刻都涉及定制模型。

truell.en: The AI shift is more consequential than the internet and will take decades; incumbents may struggle.
truell.zh: 2025 年，AI 变革比互联网影响更大，将持续数十年；现有巨头可能难以适应。

shazeer.en: LLMs trained on next-token prediction are AI-complete; scaling compute and data improves intelligence, but inner workings remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为基于下一个词预测训练的 LLM 是 AI 完备的；扩大算力和数据能提升智能，但模型内部运作仍像炼金术。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures enable efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他强调推理时算力扩展和更长上下文窗口是近期机会；模块化稀疏架构（如专家混合）可实现高效扩展。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not just passive data; continual learning with modular components could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他主张模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察数据；模块化组件的持续学习可取代整体重训。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他认为测试时算力扩展推动进步，但单独无法实现 AGI；智能体能力和强化学习至关重要。

shazeer.en: Open-source models are closing the gap with frontier models; AGI is underhyped economically, and coding enables AI self-acceleration.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他指出开源模型正缩小与前沿模型的差距；AGI 的经济影响被低估，编程能力推动 AI 自我加速。

abbeel.en: Self-play and imitation learning are strong signals for robot skill acquisition; hierarchical reasoning is missing in RL.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，强调自对弈和模仿学习是机器人技能获取的强信号，但强化学习缺乏分层推理。

abbeel.en: Fine-tuning large pre-trained models is a major success; simulation ensembles may beat single simulators.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，指出微调大型预训练模型是重大成功，模拟集成可能优于单一模拟器。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency; hard-coding prior knowledge can hurt.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，提出无监督学习结合强化学习可大幅提升样本效率，硬编码先验知识可能有害。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models transfer reasoning to non-language tasks; curiosity-driven exploration fails in open worlds.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，认为预训练语言模型可迁移推理到非语言任务，好奇心驱动探索在开放世界失效。

abbeel.en: Consistent focus on RL for robotics, transfer learning, and the gap between AI generality and human brain.
abbeel.zh: 始终关注机器人强化学习、迁移学习，以及 AI 通用性与人脑之间的差距。
